apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 177 restores a 120 Hz preferred DisplayLink cadence in Cloud G-Sync mode while retaining the 48–120 Hz adaptive range. Build 176 followed measured presentation FPS and caused iOS to select 60 Hz on the iPhone. The in-app timing diagnostic continues to report preferred rate, actual callbacks and drawable presentation FPS separately. Client measurements do not expose physical panel scanout Hz or prove server-side G-Sync acceptance. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
